exposure: Hypertensive Disorders in Pregnancy with fetoplacental Insufficiency
Twin Pregnancy with Premature rupture of membranes
cohort: The study participants were delivered women at SMS Medical College, Jaipur.
finding: The most common postpartum complication was haemorrhage (24%), and postpartum complications were found to be influenced by various personal and obstetric risk factors, with previous caesarean section being the most frequent associated factor.
mod_finding: A previous caesarean section was identified as the most common risk factor associated with postpartum complications, present in 35% of affected women.
